messages:
Gabi (Marketing): Quick sync  planning to publish the release post + changelog tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need final docs permalink, a one-line bench stat, and webinar reg link by EOD.

Hiro (Eng): Ack. Recommend canary freeze at 8:30am PT to keep rollout separate. There's a tiny batching-edge behavior I'll note in the migration guide (non-breaking).

Rae (Product): No breaking changes for typical flows. User takeaway: smarter routing for short sessions -> lower p95. I'll draft the product blurb.

Lena (Docs): Draft changelog preview: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v10-preview. Will add migration note after Hiro drops the text.

Cal (Release): Need a permalink by 6pm PT for the site pipeline. If deploy green, target merge of blog at 9:25am PT for a short QA pass before 10am.

Noor (Events): Webinar slot booked 11:00am PT (30m). Looking for an Eng co-presenter for ~10 mins. Hiro, can you do 11:00-11:10?

Hiro (Eng): Yes 11:00-11:10 works. I'll prepare a 2-slide micro-bench and export a PNG to /drive/marketing/assets by 5:00pm PT. Caption: "internal benchmark  95th percentile latency  short sessions".

Gabi (Marketing): Bench copy check: is "up to 30% lower p95 for short-chat workloads" defensible?

Hiro (Eng): 30% is near the high end for very short tests (<48 tokens). Recommend wording: "up to ~28%" to be safe.

Rae (Product): +1 to ~28%. Proposed marketing copy: "up to ~28% lower p95 latency on short-chat workloads (internal benchmark)."

Lena (Docs): Changelog snippet drafted:
```
## v10.0  Routing + cache refinements (2026-11-02)
- Adaptive routing for short-session traffic
- KV prefix cache improvements to reduce repeated compute
- Fix: stable quantization fallback for mixed-precision paths
```

Gabi (Marketing): Great. Please paste the final permalink here after the docs deploy so I can add it to the blog + tweet thread.

deploy-bot: scheduled_deploy: docs-site job 27011  ETA ~12m

Cal (Release): Monitoring the deploy. If green, we'll merge blog at 9:25am PT for Marketing QA then publish 10:00am PT.

Hiro (Eng): Uploaded bench PNG to /drive/marketing/assets/v10-bench.png at 16:22 PT.

Lena (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1021  includes migration note and prelink.

deploy-bot: docs-site job 27011  SUCCESS. Changelog live: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v10.0

Gabi (Marketing): Got the permalink. Queuing blog merge at 9:25am PT and publish 10:00am PT. Social assets scheduled for 10:05am post-publish. :tada:

Noor (Events): Webinar reg link: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/2026-11-routing-cache  speakers updated: Hiro co-presenting. Recording setup confirmed.

Hiro (Eng): I'll field live Qs during the webinar channel. Ping me there.

Cal (Release): Final checklist: docs permalink (done), changelog live (done), blog + images queued (Gabi), canary freeze 8:30am PT (Hiro), webinar confirmed (Noor), PRs merged and pipeline green (Cal). All set.
